newsitem.title: USA: Medical Graphics changes stock listing.
newsitem.headline: Medical Graphics changes stock listing.

text.p: Medical Graphics Corp said Tuesday it would need to raise additional capital to continue Nasdaq National Market listing and has chosen to change its common stock trading the Nasdaq SmallCap Market. "Medical Graphics currently has sufficient capital and borrowing capacity, so raising additional capital solely to remain on the National Market is not in the best interest of our shareholders," said Mark Sheffert, chairman of the board, in a statement.
Trading on the SmallCap Market will begin on August 20 and will continue under the symbol "MGCC."

The company said it had commitments necessary to raise additional capital, but its directors believed the negative effects of shareholder dilution outweighed the benefits of remaining on the National Market. "The SmallCap Market offers the company's shareholders sufficient liquidity and depth, and for Medical Graphics the difference between the two markets is not significant," he said.
Medical Graphics said its turnaround efforts are showing important progress, and it wants to avoid unnecessary dilution to shareholders.
Medical Graphics develops and markets diagnostic systems to manage and improve cardiorespiratory health.
